instruction: A giraffe twisted from glossy yellow party balloons, its long segmented neck, knotted joints, and stubby legs squeaking with taut latex shine. Bright specular highlights streak each inflated tube, and little brown balloon spots and tiny ossicone bumps complete the twisty-balloon charm.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Balloon Giraffe in a balloon style. A giraffe twisted from glossy yellow party balloons, its long segmented neck, knotted joints, and stubby legs squeaking with taut latex shine. Bright specular highlights streak each inflated tube, and little brown balloon spots and tiny ossicone bumps complete the twisty-balloon charm. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
